about: module board's unit-2 domain and memory-store mutants; each is killed by a canonical law or test of modules/board/board or modules/board/memory.

mutants.name: board-grant-allows-denied-channel
mutants.to: out = if r.Deny { AllPermissions() } else { r.Allow }
mutants.rule: An explicit deny grant rule closes access to the matched channel pattern rather than granting permissions.

mutants.name: board-secret-scanner-skips-aws
mutants.rule: ScanSecret detects every supported credential shape including AWS access keys.

mutants.name: board-mentions-reads-code-span
mutants.rule: SettleMentions ignores @handles inside inline and fenced code spans.

mutants.name: board-idempotency-ignores-digest
mutants.rule: Reusing an idempotency key within 24 hours with a different payload fails IdempotencyConflict.

mutants.name: board-apply-drops-reaction
mutants.to:
case ReactionChanged as p:
		let _ = p
		next
mutants.rule: Apply folds ReactionChanged events into the message's projected Reactions map.

mutants.name: board-memory-skips-expected-check
mutants.rule: Store.Commit fails StalePosition and changes nothing when expected does not match the board head.

mutants.name: board-search-leaks-private-channel
mutants.rule: Store.Search never returns messages from a channel the caller cannot read.
